summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing an amended statement of executive compensation for fiscal year ended October 31, 2025, correcting omissions and errors in the initial statement regarding compensation elements, summary compensation table, employment agreements, termination benefits, and director compensation. The filing is a routine disclosure of executive pay practices, not a special situation. The Compensation Committee, composed of independent directors, retained Global Governance Advisors Inc. as an independent consultant. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event is announced. This is standard periodic reporting for a foreign private issuer.
